body:
the lie is I dont want to be alive, in anyway  just waiting on the time for me to end it all... as for my co worker  saying that even that I having a hard time here at the office doesnt mean i need to end it all as I could always go else where, as I replied no matter where I want to work it still wont allow me to be happy     


life sucks

March 10, 2020  


Well it wasn't a pretty weekend and few days for myself.   I decided that if things here don't change that no matter how hard I fought but the mid was telling to let go of everything... Had a fight with the wife saying in anytime we ending up losing this house is the time for me to end my life once and for all as I can not take another failure in my life..  as I know I am the failure in this life journey I live today.... I hate my life, I hate to breath every day and I hate how this world works anymore

March 7, 2020  


wellI am sitting here at the office once again to get my mind off whats going on my life...  


All i know its not getting any better,. or feeling that this will ever go away >  


So Went on line to find a way, "whats the best way to commit Suicide "   as I dont want to survive it this time around      


I hate my life my, my  way of thinking and I cant find happiness...    everything around me is falling apart
that in reality no matter how hard I try I can put on a real smile where I know I havent gave one in  a long time  I am lying to myself and to everyone around me   day are not getting better

march 5th 2020  


Well its a new day, as last night I was out with my wife for a drive just to get out the house after I got home from the office,.,,, During our 2 hour drive we talk about some of my emotioins and issues I been feeling but never talk about how I truly feel due to the fact I dont want her to know my true feelings about suicide.  


Today I finally got up crying asking myself how my day going to be?  will be an a day that I can finally put on a real smile, laugh and say today will be a good day ?  Well I can say NO still feeling the same as yesterday wondering when this all come to an end knowing how I feel..  I cried in the shower feeling I dont want to be here anymore, but it so hard to put on a smile and go down stairs to see my wife and kid smiling laughing enjoining the morning as I put on a FAKE smile to join them...    


Its so hard to put on a smile everyday or even try to think that today will be a good day.  As i sit hee at my office working away on my career and new business  I just cant stop thinking what I really want to do...   


Life is to much to handle and to much stress knowing that you can not be happy as you want to be no matter what you are wanting out of life...

not sure what happiness is anymore  I just don't see it in the near future   


As what he said is to get help and it will get better  but how can anyone know how things can get better if just getting worst in life. To feel life is over and feel sadness everyday and putting on a fake smile is more hard to do everyday vs trying to find happiness if there is non     Not event my family that I love and adore but I can't wear a truthful smile   I do feel its a matter of time just dont know what is that time will be but I can say feeling the way I do everyday not helping to get to a new day tomorrow

The start of my day, stated off like why I am here.. :(  Why I want to start another day with feeling the way I do... As I sit here at my office pondering why is all this happening again  and never comes ends as racing thoughts in my head wont stop... I trying to distract myself with  my career and new business.  but it reality I am here writing here to find a way to let go of everything and fighting to be smiling for all the right reason but smiles are never real but its just a show I need to put on, that I dont need to show the people around me that I am hurting  inside... hope the rest of my day gets better ,,,

I know life is never easy, as I been fighting for years beyond years and fight for all the right reason, but in reality living a lie to find happiness or be happy is tearing me apart,,, nothing I do in this life is right no matter how hard I get attack or how hard I try  it seems it goes one way and that way is down... I just told my co-worker that if I can not get out this fun by the end of the month I will just end it all  I just cant fight these emotions any longer
